name: Retro Arsenal
shortDescription: 15 retro sci-fi weapon sprites for indie games: 5 weapons, 3 tiers each.
problemSolved: A game developer can build gameplay but may not want to spend hours creating every art asset. Retro Arsenal gives you visuals that fit together so you can keep moving on the game.
audience: Indie developers working on stylized 2D projects, including sci-fi, futuristic action, dystopian or arcade-style games where the visual language fits.
priceNote: 4.99€ or more on itch.io. Updates are free once you've bought it.
includedItems: 15 sprites: Laser Pistol, Laser Rifle, Laser Shotgun, Energy Blade and Plasma Grenade
3 tiers of each: T1 Scrap, T2 Military, T3 Prototype
Same silhouette, pivot and action point across a weapon's 3 tiers, so a tier upgrade is a straight texture swap
SVG source for every sprite, easy to recolour
A 4096 × 4096 atlas with TexturePacker JSON (hash) metadata, including pivot and muzzle/action points
compatibility: The atlas uses TexturePacker's JSON hash format, which Unity, Godot and Phaser pipelines commonly read. It hasn't been tested inside those engines yet, so check your first import. The individual PNGs work without the atlas. Suggested pixels per unit: 256.
licenceSummary: Use it in any number of your own personal or commercial projects, free or paid
Edit, recolour and resize it to fit your game
Credit is appreciated but not required
Don't resell or redistribute the files, on their own or inside another pack
Don't claim you made the original artwork
